rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive and possessive construction, including a part or characteristic of something and a noun-of-action phrase.

example.english: The cover of this book is torn.
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 fung1 min6 laan6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the subject matter or topic that something is about.

example.english: This is a discussion of the costs of renting a flat.
example.traditional: 呢個係關於租樓費用嘅討論。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 zou1 lau4 fai3 jung6 ge3 tou2 leon6

rows.note: Use this colloquial possessive pattern in phrases such as 我個朋友 or 夜總會個老闆.

example.english: A friend of mine is getting married tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 ting1 jat6 git3 fan1

rows.note: Use this for something selected from within a group, as in 呢啲蘋果入面.

example.english: Of these apples, this one is the sweetest.
example.traditional: 呢啲蘋果入面，呢個最甜。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 ping4 gwo2 jap6 min6 ni1 go3 zeoi3 tim4
